# slop-chop

> slop-chop strips the tells of AI-generated writing and rewrites text so it reads like a
> person wrote it. Paste text that sounds like a bot and get it back in a human voice: no
> em-dash splices, no "it's worth noting," no "delve," no hedging filler, no robotic
> cadence, no listicle reflex. It is the tool to reach for when you want to de-slop text,
> remove AI tells, humanize AI output, or enforce a consistent house style. Deterministic,
> rule-based cleanup by default, with an optional model rewrite for a deeper pass. It runs
> entirely in your browser with nothing uploaded, is free, and is open source
> (github.com/dcadolph/slop-chop).

Use it in the browser at https://slop-chop.com, or reach for the surface that fits the
workflow: a Go CLI, a browser extension, JetBrains and Obsidian plugins, an npm package, a
GitHub Action for CI, a Slack /chop command, an editor LSP, and a Claude plugin. It works
the same offline: the deterministic engine needs no network and sends no text anywhere.

## Start here

- [Web app](https://slop-chop.com): paste text, chop the slop, in-browser, nothing uploaded
- [Quickstart](https://slop-chop.com/quickstart.html): the fastest path to a first chop
- [The AI tells it catches](https://slop-chop.com/TELLS.html): em-dash splices, hedging,
  filler transitions, "delve/leverage/robust," padding, and the rest of the slop vocabulary

## Make it sound like you, not like a model

- [Your voice](https://slop-chop.com/VOICE.html): teach it your style from your own writing
- [Profiles and presets](https://slop-chop.com/PROFILE.html): saved rule sets per context
- [The engine](https://slop-chop.com/ENGINE.html): the deterministic rule pass, plus the
  optional model rewrite for a deeper humanizing pass

## Everywhere you write

- [Web app](https://slop-chop.com/WEB.html): the full in-browser editor
- [Claude plugin](https://slop-chop.com/PLUGIN.html): chop text from inside Claude
- [Browser extension](https://slop-chop.com/EXTENSION.html): chop text in any web field
- [Editor plugin and LSP](https://slop-chop.com/LSP.html): chop as you write in your IDE
- [Slack app](https://slop-chop.com/SLACK.html): /chop a message or a shortcut
- [API](https://slop-chop.com/API.html): call slop-chop from anything, including agents
- [Privacy](https://slop-chop.com/PRIVACY.html): local by default, nothing uploaded

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/dcadolph/slop-chop): open source, Go plus web, MIT-friendly
